protocol.order: case-dependent rotation; reversed on alternate rounds
protocol.selection_rule: No changed greedy outputs, finite first-token logprobs, exact preprocessing tensors, and positive lower bound of paired bootstrap latency reduction. Timing is replay, not gameplay.

methodology_notes: First-pass preprocessing wrapper was bypassed by the MLX custom processor; its zero-hit cache variant is excluded as optimization evidence.
Prefill comparisons remain valid: same full prompts and images, warmed variants, counterbalanced order.
Bootstrap bounds are exploratory timing estimates from repeated windows, not independent gameplay runs.
Window-cluster bootstrap treats repeated timings of each corpus/window as a cluster; these remain exploratory small-corpus replay estimates.
hardware: Apple M5 Pro, 24 GB unified memory
